Adverse Events - N (%) | All-Cause Grade.note: p8 Table 3 has mutually exclusive 'Worst grade' rows: Grade 3 248 (38.0) + Grade 4 183 (28.1) + Grade 5 27 (4.1) = 458 of 652, and p7 cites Table 3 for 'grade 3 to 5 adverse events'. The final 431 (66.1%) is the printed grade 3-or-4 figure, which leaves out grade 5. The paper prints no percentage for the 3-5 total (70.2% would have to be computed), so only the count is given. This is the same sum as round 1 without the computed rate.

p8 Table 3 'Worst grade' rows for placebo (N=650): Grade 3 232 (35.7) + Grade 4 181 (27.8) + Grade 5 26 (4.0) = 439. The final 413 (63.5%) is the grade 3-or-4 figure from the p8 text, which leaves out grade 5. No 3-5 percentage is printed (67.5% would be computed), so only the count is given.

p5 Table 1 'Metastasis stage at initial diagnosis': M1, distant metastasis 566 (86.5) in the placebo arm (N=654). This is metastatic disease at initial diagnosis, so synchronous/de novo.
